create_pose_from_position_quaternion: create a Pose from position and quaternion arrays using Pose.new()
compute_relative_pose: compute the relative pose between two frames using Pose.inv().mul()
convert_pose_to_homogeneous_matrix: convert a Pose to a 4x4 homogeneous matrix using Pose.to_hmat()
create_pose_from_posrot6: create a Pose from a 9-dimensional posrot6 array using Pose.from_posrot6()
convert_pose_to_posaxisangle: convert a Pose to a 6-dimensional posaxisangle array using Pose.to_posaxisangle()
